# bioconductor-psmatch

## Overview

Use the Bioconductor R package **PSMatch** for: The package also provides functions to calculate and visualise MS2 fragment ions.

## Installation

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("PSMatch")
```
